title: Abiathar and Joab are removed from power
description: Solomon removes the priest Abiathar and sends him to Anathoth, so that the word of the Lord against the house of Eli is fulfilled. Joab flees to the tent of the Lord and grabs the horns of the altar, but Benaiah executes him on the king's command to atone for the bloodguilt from the murders of Abner and Amasa. Benaiah is placed over the army, and Zadok becomes priest in Abiathar's place. [ref:1 Kings 2:26-35|1 Kings 2:26-35]
